entities.name: Adam the Firstborn

meta.lore: A culminação da genialidade do Doutor Henry Blackbrew, The Monster seria o próximo passo da evolução humana, a máquina de guerra definitiva. É tão poderoso quanto Blackbrew poderia ter desejado, mas provou ser impossível de controlar. Os Trancendum fizeram tudo o que puderam para conter The Monster, e tiveram sucesso em fazê-lo... por enquanto.
meta.fightGuide:
Adam is an incredibly fast and aggressive boss, nearly always being within melee range of the player. This Combined with stage hazards, attacks that cover nearly the entire arena and a second phase make Adam an incredibly difficult fight, especially if fought alone. His attacks are as follow:
Lightning Towers - The arena which Adam is fought within has eight lightning towers, two on each wall. Towers opposite one another create a continuous stream of lightning that deals damage and slows the player as long as they remain within it. A pair of towers can be deactivated by dealing sufficient damage to one of the towers. Adam will start the fight by activating all towers. Occasionally, Adam will reactivate a pair of towers. He can do this in both phases.

Upgraded , and an upgrade of the  is the best equipment for the fight. For weapons, crossbows are very hard to use during the fight due to Adam giving the player little time to fire due to him being so close all the time. However, the player may want to bring a crossbow as a secondary weapon to deal with the lighting towers from further away. Pistols don't run into this problem as much due to their faster firing and shorter range. In fact, pistols as well as greatswords can be great choices to deal with one of Adam's more problematic attack. Whatever weapon the player ends up using, it should be either sanguine or ancestral.
Hard hitting abilities with good range can be used to destroy the lightning towers and free up space for the player. Counters and blocks have less attacks to defend against due to Adam's very high count of area damage. That said, these defensive abilities are still useful to deal with Adam's melee attacks and should still be considered.
For ultimates,  's mix of defense and offense works great against Adam who will usually stay within the area of affect of the ultimate willingly, though the player should be careful where they dash when the ability ends.

General Tips: The lightning towers effectively split the arena into an uneven 3x3 grid. Depending on which area you find yourself within, it will become much harder to dodge Adam if you don't deactivate the towers to make room or if you don't dash over the lightning beams to get to a more spacious part. It's advised to spend the beginning of the fight to deactivate most if not all of the towers. After that, the fight becomes more manageable. However, the player should make sure to keep the towers deactivated. If not, the player will find themselves in situations where it  will be incredibly hard to dodge Adam's attacks or even outright impossible to get out of a tough spot without taking damage. Lastly, Adam's attacks that displace or throw the player can be very dangerous while there are still lightning towers active as Adam can force you on top of the beams, often times stunning you on top of them.

phases.title: Phase 1
phases.body:
*   **Dash** - Se o jogador estiver muito longe de Adam, The Monster fará um dash em sua direção. Este dash não tem outros efeitos além de mover Adam em direção ao jogador.
*   **Slash Combo** - Adam fará um slash à sua frente com seu braço-lâmina, uma vez para a esquerda e depois uma vez para a direita. Cada slash libera um projétil de onda de rocha na direção do slash, causando dano ao jogador. Após os slashes, Adam golpeará o chão à sua frente, causando dano em linha. Três ondas de rocha serão lançadas da ponta da lâmina de Adam em um cone depois que ele golpear.
*   **Agarre** - Adam dará um passo à frente na tentativa de agarrar o jogador. Se ele conseguir, arremessará o jogador pela arena, causando dano e atordoando-o ao cair.
*   **Pisotão** - Adam pisoteará o chão, causando dano ao seu redor e liberando ondas de rocha em um padrão fixo ao seu redor.
*   **Olho da Tempestade** - Adam parará para conjurar uma tempestade, empurrando os jogadores próximos para trás assim que terminar. Durante a tempestade, raios atingirão a arena, causando dano aos jogadores. Adam continuará a atacar normalmente enquanto a tempestade estiver ativa.
*   **Escudo** - A partir de aproximadamente 80% de vida, Adam rapidamente se protegerá com um escudo e empurrará o jogador para uma curta distância. Enquanto protegido, Adam não pode sofrer dano, mover-se ou atacar. Acertar Adam enquanto o escudo persiste fará com que projéteis de raio sejam lançados ao redor de The Monster em padrões aparentemente aleatórios.
*   **Espetada** - A partir de aproximadamente 50% de vida, Adam fará um dash rápido na frente do jogador e tentará espetá-lo. Se for bem-sucedido, ele pegará o jogador e causará dano. Em seguida, ele o arremessará no chão ao seu lado, causando dano novamente e infligindo um breve atordoamento.
*   **Sem Escapatória** - A partir de aproximadamente 50% de vida, Adam avançará rapidamente por trás do jogador e então golpeará o chão, afetando a área em um cone à sua frente. Se o jogador estiver nessa área, ele sofrerá dano, será arremessado para longe de Adam e ficará incapacitado.
*   **Campo de Raios** - A partir de aproximadamente 30% de vida, Adam levará um momento para criar inicialmente quatro minas elétricas ao seu redor. Em seguida, as minas se espalharão lentamente por toda a arena, persistindo por um tempo. As minas detonarão ocasionalmente, causando dano ao seu redor sem desaparecer. O jogador sofrerá dano continuamente enquanto estiver em contato com uma mina.

phases.title: Phase 2
phases.body:
### BLOCO 2
Depois que a vida de Adam for esgotada, ele cairá por um momento antes de quebrar seu braço-lâmina, substituindo-o por um braço de raio e iniciando a fase 2. Durante esta fase, Adam perde o acesso ao seu Slash Combo, Espetada, Pisotão e Sem Escapatória, mantendo todo o resto enquanto ganha novos ataques.
*   **Lightning Swipes** - Adam fará swipes rápidos à sua frente, uma vez para a esquerda e depois uma vez para a direita, liberando linhas de eletricidade enquanto faz os swipes. Em seguida, Adam fará um dash rápido por trás do jogador e golpeará o chão, causando dano em linha reta à sua frente.
*   **Hélice** - Se o jogador estiver muito longe de Adam, ele lançará dois projéteis rápidos de bola de raio em sua direção que viajam em um padrão de hélice dupla. Ambos os projéteis causam dano e incapacitam o jogador se o atingirem.
*   **Raio da Morte** - Adam levará um momento para invocar um raio da morte sobre o jogador. Pouco depois de surgir, o raio da morte começará a causar dano ao jogador enquanto ele permanecer dentro de sua área de efeito. O raio da morte perseguirá o jogador e persistirá durante os ataques subsequentes de Adam.
*   **Salto da Tempestade** - Adam saltará no ar, invocando uma tempestade enquanto salta. Como esperado, raios atingirão continuamente enquanto a tempestade estiver ativa. Assim que a tempestade terminar, Adam cairá sobre o jogador, causando dano e incapacitando em uma grande área.

phases.title: Phase 1
phases.body:
Slash Combo: The attack can be completely dodged if the player keeps a short distance from Adam then moving to their left (Adam's right) when he performs the first swing, then the opposite direction on the second swing. After which, the player only needs to sidestep the slam as the rock waves will spawn behind the player if they keep close enough to Adam since the waves spawn out of the tip of his blade rather than himself. The player can also avoid this attack by making distance between themselves and Adam as he will not attempt to reposition once he starts the attack at which point the player should focus on dodging the rock waves that follow. Lastly, the player can also dash behind Adam to avoid the attack. However, unlike with other bosses who have attacks dodged this way, Adam can still reach the player with his wide swings, even if he doesn't see you. You should also wait for Adam to start his slam before attacking as he can turn very quickly to hit you. Any attack in this combo can be countered or blocked.
Grab:  The grab can be walked away from and sidestepped, albeit this is rather unreliable. Therefore, the safest way to avoid getting grabbed is using your Travel Ability or other similar effects, such as the second ability of the greatsword or pistols. The grab is Adam's longest stun and will do a lot of damage if he decides to toss you on top of a lightning tower's beam. However, if you do get grabbed and land near a tower, it will take Adam a few seconds to reach you again, time which could be used to deactivate a tower. The grab CANNOT be countered or blocked.
Stomp: Adam's stomp doesn't have an indicator as to where it will deal damage. If the player stands a modest distance away from Adam then the initial stomp will be avoided. If the player isn't sure of the rock wave pattern it is fairly safe to use a counter or block to avoid being hit by them.
Eye of the Storm: The lightning bolts are obvious to dodge. However, the initial cast of this ability can prove dangerous as well depending on your positioning relative to Adam as this can knock you backwards into the beam of lightning towers. As such, keep a distance from Adam by the time he is casting or angle yourself in such way that going straight backwards wouldn't go into a lightning beam in the case that one is nearby.
Shield: Since the shield makes it impossible to interact with Adam directly, the player should start damaging the lightning towers while the shield holds. The player should also be careful if they have any projectile that lingers such as a reaper's second ability as it will trigger the shield to fire bolts once it is applied.
Skewer and No Escape: These two attacks are being addressed at once because of the fact that they can be easily confused with one another. Avoiding this generally comes down to reaction time due to the speed Adam performs the attacks. Generally speaking, dashing backwards or using similar effects will dodge both attacks. As for specifics, Skewer can sometimes be sidestepped but it can also be countered or blocked, while No Escape can be dodged by walking towards Adam and slightly to the side after he dashes behind you.

phases.title: Phase 2
phases.body:
O tempo que Adam leva para se levantar deve ser usado para desativar quaisquer torres de raio que possam estar atualmente ativadas.
Lightning Swipes: Embora os dois 'swipes' iniciais pudessem ser desviados de forma semelhante aos 'slashes' da primeira fase, eles são muito mais rápidos e difíceis de ver onde exatamente atingirão, tornando isso não confiável. Sendo assim, criar distância com seu 'dash', contra-atacar ou bloquear esses 'swipes' é a melhor escolha. Quanto ao 'slam', ele deve ser evitado andando para o lado. Notavelmente, este 'slam' não pode ser contra-atacado ou bloqueado.
Helix: Devido à velocidade e ao padrão incomum dos dois projéteis, pode ser muito difícil desviar deste ataque usando apenas seu movimento. Sendo assim, é aconselhável ficar perto de Adam se o jogador não quiser lidar com este ataque. Dito tudo isso, o ataque pode ser desviado permanecendo dentro da lacuna que será formada no padrão de hélice dupla dos projéteis.
Storm Leap: Você NÃO PODE 'dash' para fora da área de efeito que surge quando Adam cai ou contra-atacá-lo. Você pode, no entanto, usar o tempo de imunidade do 'dash' para evitar o dano ou usar outros efeitos semelhantes. Se, no entanto, você não tiver tais efeitos, NÃO use seu 'dash' durante a tempestade, mesmo que isso signifique ser atingido por um raio, pois você não o terá de volta a tempo e a queda de Adam causa mais dano. No entanto, para este ataque especificamente, poderia ser uma boa escolha para lhe dar pelo menos um 'dash' antes que Adam caia.

infobox.location: Doctor Blackbrew's Castle in Gloomrot North
infobox.description: The culmination of Doctor Henry Blackbrew's brilliance, The Monster was to be the next step of human evolution, the ultimate machine of war. It is as powerful as Blackbrew could have ever desired but proved impossible to control. The Trancendum has done everything it can to contain The Monster, and they've been successful in doing so... for now.

sections.title: Location
sections.body:
Adam pode ser encontrado no Castelo do Doutor Blackbrew, na borda ocidental de Gloomrot norte, acima dos Laboratórios Trancendum.

O acesso ao chefe é bloqueado por um portão e uma porta. Cada um pode ser destruído por 1 hora usando um . Alternativamente, é possível voar sobre o portão usando  para economizar 1 EMP. Também é possível contornar ambos os obstáculos ao sair, passando por uma brecha na parede perto do interruptor e depois saltando do penhasco.

sections.title: Attacks
sections.body:
### BLOCO 2
Adam é um chefe incrivelmente rápido e agressivo, quase sempre permanecendo no alcance corpo a corpo do jogador. Isso, combinado com os perigos do cenário, ataques que cobrem quase toda a arena e uma segunda fase, torna Adam uma luta incrivelmente difícil, especialmente se enfrentado sozinho. Seus ataques são os seguintes:
Torres de Raio - A arena onde Adam é enfrentado possui oito torres de raio, duas em cada parede. Torres opostas umas às outras criam um fluxo contínuo de raio que causa dano e retarda o jogador enquanto ele permanecer nele. Um par de torres pode ser desativado ao causar dano suficiente a uma das torres. Adam iniciará a luta ativando todas as torres. Ocasionalmente, Adam reativará um par de torres. Ele pode fazer isso em ambas as fases.

sections.title: Phase 1
sections.body:
**Dash** - Se o jogador estiver muito longe de Adam, The Monster irá avançar em sua direção. Este avanço não tem outros efeitos além de mover Adam em direção ao jogador.
**Slash Combo** - Adam irá golpear à sua frente com seu braço-lâmina, uma vez para a esquerda e depois uma vez para a direita. Cada golpe libera um projétil de onda de rocha na direção do golpe, causando dano ao jogador. Após os golpes, Adam irá golpear o chão à sua frente, causando dano em linha. Três ondas de rocha serão lançadas da ponta da lâmina de Adam em um cone depois que ele golpear o chão.
**Grab** - Adam dará um passo à frente na tentativa de agarrar o jogador. Se ele conseguir, ele arremessará o jogador pela arena, causando dano e atordoando-o ao aterrissar.
**Stomp** - Adam irá pisar no chão, causando dano ao seu redor e liberando ondas de rocha em um padrão fixo ao seu redor.
**Eye of the Storm** - Adam irá parar para conjurar uma tempestade, empurrando os jogadores próximos para trás assim que ele terminar. Durante a tempestade, raios cairão por toda a arena, causando dano aos jogadores. Adam continuará a atacar normalmente enquanto a tempestade estiver acontecendo.
**Shield** - Começando em cerca de 80% de vida, Adam irá rapidamente se proteger e empurrar o jogador para trás uma curta distância. Enquanto protegido, Adam não pode sofrer dano, mover-se ou atacar. Acertar Adam enquanto o escudo persistir fará com que projéteis de raio sejam lançados ao redor de The Monster em padrões aparentemente aleatórios.
**Skewer** - Começando em cerca de 50% de vida, Adam irá avançar rapidamente na frente do jogador e então tentar empalá-lo. Se ele for bem-sucedido, ele pegará o jogador e causará dano a ele. Depois, ele o arremessará no chão ao lado dele, causando dano novamente e infligindo um breve atordoamento.
**No Escape** - Começando em cerca de 50% de vida, Adam irá avançar rapidamente por trás do jogador e então golpear o chão, afetando a área em um cone à sua frente. Se o jogador estiver nessa área, ele sofrerá dano, será arremessado para longe de Adam e ficará incapacitado.
**Lightning Field** - Começando em cerca de 30% de vida, Adam levará um momento para criar inicialmente quatro minas elétricas ao seu redor. Depois, as minas se espalharão lentamente por toda a arena, persistindo por um tempo. As minas detonarão ocasionalmente, causando dano ao seu redor sem desaparecer. O jogador sofrerá dano continuamente enquanto estiver em contato com uma mina.

sections.title: Phase 2
sections.body:
### BLOCO 2
Depois que a vida de Adam for esgotada, ele cairá por um momento antes de quebrar seu braço-lâmina, substituindo-o por um braço de raio e iniciando a fase 2. Durante esta fase, Adam perde acesso ao seu Slash Combo, Skewer, Stomp e No Escape, mantendo todo o resto enquanto ganha novos ataques.
**Lightning Swipes** - Adam irá golpear rapidamente à sua frente, uma vez para a esquerda e depois uma vez para a direita, liberando linhas de eletricidade enquanto golpeia. Depois, Adam irá avançar rapidamente por trás do jogador e golpear o chão, causando dano em linha reta à sua frente.
**Helix** - Se o jogador estiver muito longe de Adam, ele lançará dois projéteis rápidos de bola de raio em sua direção que viajam em um padrão de dupla hélice. Ambos os projéteis causam dano e incapacitam o jogador se eles se conectarem.
**Death Ray** - Adam levará um momento para invocar um raio da morte em cima do jogador. Pouco depois de surgir, o raio da morte começará a causar dano ao jogador enquanto ele permanecer dentro de sua área de efeito. O raio da morte perseguirá o jogador e persistirá através dos ataques subsequentes de Adam.
**Storm Leap** - Adam irá saltar no ar, invocando uma tempestade enquanto salta. Como esperado, raios cairão continuamente enquanto a tempestade se enfurece. Assim que a tempestade terminar, Adam cairá sobre o jogador, causando dano e incapacitando em uma grande área.

sections.title: Other notes
sections.body:
Os golpes e ataques de Adam alcançam tanto os seus lados quanto um pouco atrás dele.
Adam inicia a fase dois com metade da vida. Devido a isso, ele também não gera orbes de cura adicionais durante esta fase.
As Lightning Towers podem bloquear os projéteis de Adam.
O dash de Adam pode, às vezes, fazê-lo avançar para trás do jogador.
Apenas para o Brutal: A luta dele permanece inalterada, exceto pelas suas Lightning Towers. Elas começarão com Escudo/Invulneráveis até que o escudo caia após um tempo definido, que você pode derrubar, mas ele voltará com escudo e o processo se repetirá.

sections.title: Equipment and Abilities
sections.body:
### BLOCO 2
Aprimorados , e um aprimoramento do é o melhor equipamento para a luta. Para armas, bestas são muito difíceis de usar durante a luta devido a Adam dar pouco tempo ao jogador para atirar por ele estar sempre tão perto. No entanto, o jogador pode querer trazer uma besta como arma secundária para lidar com as Lightning Towers de mais longe. Pistolas não enfrentam tanto esse problema devido à sua cadência de tiro mais rápida e menor alcance. Na verdade, pistolas, assim como espadões, podem ser ótimas escolhas para lidar com um dos ataques mais problemáticos de Adam. Seja qual for a arma que o jogador acabar usando, ela deve ser Sanguine ou Ancestral.

Habilidades de alto dano com bom alcance podem ser usadas para destruir as Lightning Towers e liberar espaço para o jogador. Contra-ataques e bloqueios têm menos ataques para se defender devido à altíssima quantidade de dano em área de Adam. Dito isso, essas habilidades defensivas ainda são úteis para lidar com os ataques corpo a corpo de Adam e ainda devem ser consideradas.

Para as habilidades supremas, a mistura de defesa e ataque de funciona muito bem contra Adam, que geralmente permanecerá voluntariamente dentro da área de efeito da habilidade suprema, embora o jogador deva ter cuidado onde ele avança quando a habilidade termina.

sections.title: The Fight
sections.body: Dicas Gerais: As torres de raio dividem efetivamente a arena em uma grade irregular de 3x3. Dependendo da área em que você se encontra, ficará muito mais difícil desviar de Adam se você não desativar as torres para abrir espaço ou se você não usar o dash sobre os feixes de raio para chegar a uma parte mais espaçosa. É aconselhável gastar o início da luta para desativar a maioria, se não todas, as torres. Depois disso, a luta se torna mais gerenciável. No entanto, o jogador deve se certificar de manter as torres desativadas. Caso contrário, o jogador se encontrará em situações onde será incrivelmente difícil desviar dos ataques de Adam ou até mesmo impossível sair de uma situação complicada sem sofrer dano. Por fim, os ataques de Adam que deslocam ou arremessam o jogador podem ser muito perigosos enquanto ainda houver torres de raio ativas, pois Adam pode forçá-lo para cima dos feixes, muitas vezes atordoando você sobre eles.

meta.lore: O patriarca de uma família que outrora possuía terras quando esses pântanos eram adequadamente habitados. Com o tempo, a terra amaldiçoada os distorceu, deixando este sapo horrível e distorcido que só se lembra de sua luxúria por ouro e joias. Ele guarda ciosamente seu tesouro de moedas esquecidas e sem valor.

infobox.description: The patriarch of a family that once held land when these swamps were adequately inhabited. Over time, the cursed land twisted them, leaving this horrible, twisted toad that only remembers its lust for gold and jewels. It jealously guards its hoard of forgotten, worthless currency.

sections.title: Location
sections.body: Albert pode ser encontrado no [https://vrising.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Vardoran?marker=53 Swamp of Greed], na borda norte da Cursed Forest.

entities.name: Alpha, o Lobo Branco

meta.lore: A trilha deste cheiro carrega a assinatura inconfundível de Dracula, o Rei Imortal. Quando Dracula caiu, ele amaldiçoou o mundo de Vardoran com uma chuva de sangue, um flagelo no qual muitos pereceram. Alguns que sobreviveram foram, sem saber, distorcidos pela chuva, suas linhagens para sempre fortalecidas por sua malícia. Este poderoso predador está infundido com esse legado.
meta.fightGuide:
Mordida - Ataque corpo a corpo padrão.
Investida - O Alpha Wolf se agacha por um segundo em preparação e então se lança para frente em linha reta.
Fúria - O Alpha Wolf uiva e brilha em vermelho, se lança em linha reta e morde 2 vezes.
Invocar Lacaios - O Alpha Wolf para por um momento, uiva e invoca 2 lobos comuns para se juntar à luta.

infobox.description: The trail of this scent bears the unmistakable signature of Dracula, the Immortal King. When Dracula fell, he cursed the world of Vardoran with a blood rain, a scourge in which many perished. Some who survived became unknowingly twisted by the downpour, their bloodlines forever empowered by his malice. This mighty predator is infused with that legacy.

sections.title: Location
sections.body: O Alpha Wolf pode ser encontrado vagando pelas estradas da região de Farbane Woods. Ele tende a caminhar pelas estradas em um circuito ao redor da parte central da região, perto da [https://vrising.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Vardoran?marker=81 Wolf Den]. Ele frequentemente cruzará caminhos e lutará contra Lidia the Chaos Archer e Goreswine the Ravager. Ele também lutará contra qualquer inimigo Bandit ou Undead que cruzar seu caminho.

sections.title: Attacks
sections.body:
Bite - Ataque corpo a corpo padrão.
Lunge - O Alpha Wolf se agacha por um segundo em preparação e então se lança para frente em linha reta.
Rage - O Alpha Wolf uiva e brilha em vermelho, se lança em linha reta e morde 2 vezes.
Summon Minions - O Alpha Wolf para por um momento, uiva, e invoca 2 lobos comuns para se juntarem à luta.

entities.name: Angram the Purifier

meta.lore: Um servo dedicado do Trancendum, Angram era um exterminador que possuía uma crueldade natural e resiliência incomparáveis a qualquer um de seus pares. Como qualquer bom soldado, ele deu a vida por sua causa... ou tentou, de qualquer forma. Doutor Henry Blackbrew não podia deixar tal recurso ser desperdiçado e o trouxe de volta à vida com uma cirurgia brutal à qual poucos outros seres poderiam sobreviver. Angram vive agora, ao mero custo de cada último pedaço de sua humanidade.

meta.lore: A true politician, Azariel wormed his way to the top of the ranks of the Church of Luminance with cold, calculated social grace. Few can match his power and dedication to the Light short of Solarus the Immaculate himself, and none within the church would dare contradict his word.

entities.name: Bane the Shadowblade

meta.lore: Once a formidable swordsman and legendary graverobber, Bane was caught by the Cult of the Damned during one of his many heists. Seeing the benefit of his talent for infiltration, instead of killing him, they corrupted him into a servant of undeath. It's said that his clandestine abilities were crucial in the capture and corruption of the Iron Mine over the Militia.
meta.fightGuide:
Triple Slash - Ele irá te golpear três vezes. O terceiro ataque é um avanço que irá te incapacitar.
Triple Knife Throw - Ele irá se afastar rapidamente de você e lançar três facas em sua direção.
Dark Spin - Suas frases serão todas sobre Escuridão ou magia Negra. Ele fará um golpe AoE roxo que o cerca.
Teleport Strike - Ele irá se teleportar para fora da vista e reaparecer perto de você para atacar, o que irá te incapacitar.
Into the Shadows - Ele dirá uma de suas poucas frases enfatizando que irá desaparecer, mas irá invocar uma multidão de figuras encapuzadas (muito parecido com quando você o atinge para iniciar a luta), ele será uma delas, danificar uma que não seja ele irá invocar Skeletal Warrior e Undead Assassins.
Shadow Clone - Com menos de 50% de vida, seu avanço do lançamento de facas deixará uma sombra persistente que também lançará facas em você.
Brutal and Incursion Rift: Seu ataque de Faca pode ser encadeado várias vezes seguidas. Apenas para Incursion, seu movimento Into the Shadow terá uma aura acima dele, mas os lacaios invocados são Draculin mobs.

Diz-se que suas habilidades clandestinas foram cruciais na captura e corrupção da Iron Mine sobre a Militia.

entities.name: Baron du Bouchon the Sommelier

meta.lore: Formerly a traveling swordsman-for-hire, the good baron earned his title of Grand Sommelier after winning a taste contest hosted by the Church of Luminance. His abilities were so extraordinary, it's said that he can name the ingredients, their ages, and their place of origin with only a sip of brew. Though his new position offers him all the worldly goods he could desire, those who know him well suspect he may miss the taste of blood on the tip of his blade most of all.
meta.fightGuide:
Barrel roll - Baron drinks of his wineglass, causing two or three waves of barrels to roll from one side of the room to the other side. they deal heavy damage and stun on hit. Cannot be blocked, but can be damaged and destroyed. Baron himself will jump over them, cancelling any ability he is casting.
Wine bolt - Baron charges and throws a wine bolt, dealing damage.
Counter - Baron stands still while blocking any projectile or attacks hitting him. Area targeted abilites may still damage him.
Barrel dance - baron starts a barrel dance, causing barrels to roll from the entrance side of the room to the other side. these can be dodged and don't usually need to be destroyed.

entities.name: Ben the Old Wanderer

meta.lore: This old survivalist seeked to explore the Cursed Forest, despite knowing it's dangers. As the curse began to cloud his mind, he found ways to fight against it. With his cloak and a helpful little wisp he'd captured in a lantern, his strange magical defense prevented the curse from taking full control. Though it was too late to prevent his mind from falling to tatters, he still does what he does best... survive.
meta.fightGuide:
Like Beatrice the Tailor, this V Blood runs away from the player instead of fighting them, leading every mob in the region to attack the player while hiding within the fog generated by the Curse of the Forest. Unlike Beatrice however, The Old Wanderer has at least two defensive moves that he will use if the player gets too close. With the Update 1.0, Gorecrusher the Behemoth also roams the Cursed Forest, making him that much harder to kill.
Knockback - He'll swing his staff and knockback the player.
Wisps - He'll release 3 wisps that inflict Entangled, immobilizing the player for a couple seconds.
Brutal and Incursion - While his fight remains unchanged by running away, he will summon his wisps as he gets damaged too.

entities.name: Christina the Sun Priestess

meta.lore: When the Church of Luminance first discovered the abilities granted by the blood rain, they took it as a blessing from the Light, incidentally masking the truth of Dracula’s influence. Christina is one such faithful servant of the church. This cruel disciplinarian takes her continued mastery of Light as evidence that her torturous methods of enforcing her beliefs are a necessary tenet of her faith, and she very much enjoys proving her righteousness.
meta.fightGuide:
Staff Swipe - If the player or a minion is in melee range of her, she raises her staff and swings it in a medium arc in front of her after a brief delay.
Holy Rays - She aims her staff like a gun, before firing 5 fast-moving holy missiles in a fan in front of her.
Holy Wrath - She plants her staff in the ground and calls down an AoE beacon of holy light upon the player's position after a brief delay. The AoE slows the player's movement before exploding after a couple seconds delay.
Shining Blessings - After she has lost health, she occasionally shouts "Shining Blessings!", raises her staff in the air, and becomes stationary while slowly healing herself. She cannot use any other abilities while channeling this one. Abilities which stun enemies (such as the Iron tier and higher Axes' X-Strike ability) will interrupt her healing.
Conviction Counter - If the player is close to her, she shouts "This is my conviction!", surrounding herself in Holy light and counters all incoming attacks. Anyone who hits this counter will be silenced for several seconds.
Summon Militia - She shouts "I will show you discipline!" and summons a Militia Crossbowman and Militia Guard to come to her defense.

entities.name: Cyril the Cursed Smith

meta.lore: Cursed with eternal life and servitude to the Cult of the Damned, Cyril has little desire to perform his duties. However, having been traded to the Cult before he had even been born, this tortured life is all he knows. Resigned to his fate, he does still take some small joy in inflicting his pain on others.
meta.fightGuide:
Cyril himself has access to an arsenal of weapons, each with a specific ability. He can also forge spectral weapons, which cast their abilities shortly after Cyril casts the ability of the same weapon.
List of the weapons with their corresponding abilities:
Sword - Dash forward, then cleave
Spear - Dash backward, then throw a piercing spear
Mace - Levitate, then slam down and create spheres in a ring around the caster, spirally traveling outward.
Slashers - Slash trice, then Dash forward and backward.
Cyril also has these abilities which he casts himself:
Create weapon - Cyril creates a new spectral weapon to fight alongside him.
Create multiple weapons - Cyril creates all four spectral weapons. starting at 50% health
Dash - Cyril will dash four times in a row. starting at 30% health.

entities.name: Dantos the Forgebinder

meta.lore: Dantos is a master of weapons, fascinated by both their construction and application. A true obsessive, his borderline inhuman dedication to his craft made him an excellent tool for his Queen, the great witch Megara. After a time, their monstrous similarities brought them closer, and Dantos became her personal strategist as well as a close confidant. Inspired by Megara's secrets, it was Dantos who discovered that Venom Sap could be used to separate magical alloys, allowing the fusion of powerful artifacts into even greater weapons.

entities.name: Drácula, o Rei Imortal

meta.lore:
When Dracula fell centuries ago, it seemed like the Church of Luminance had done the impossible. The death of the Immortal King. However, in his final moments, Dracula enacted his final gambit and cast a cloud over Vardoran. The blood rain that followed would plant the seeds of Dracula’s will across the realm, twisting it, and filling it with his storied essence.

After death, the Immortal King’s soul was cast out to where his otherworldly powers originated, the Shadow Realm. There he lingered, biding his time. Now the time has come. Dracula floods the world with his monstrous Legion of Noctum, having them gather the blood necessary for him to become whole once more and return to Vardoran.
meta.fightGuide:
Teleport - Whenever the Player is out his reach, he will teleport and do his stab, slash, or axe attack.
Wolf Rush - He will transform into a wolf and rush behind you and will slash at you.
Crimson Slasher - He will swing his sword vertically twice shooting beams from right to left.
Dread Stab - He will teleport and Stab you with his sword, which will also Incapacitate you.
Blood Wave - He will stab his sword into the ground causing six beams to rush out.
Howling Axes - He will teleport away from you in one of the corners of the arena to throw two axes that circle towards you and then back to Dracula. They can be blocked by a pillar or ward.  They may change course dramatically if Dracula uses a teleport while they are in flight.
Crimson Bats - Will use this move at 75%, often paired with his Teleport.
Bloody Spiral - Dracula begins shooting out a spiral of blood bolts in 3 directions at once.  Meanwhile a ring closes in on you.  If you remain in the ring its whole duration you will be stunned and then hit backwards.
Writhing Crimson Night - He will teleport out of view, darken your screen and summon crimson bats that will partial predict your movement, which can be destroyed, blocked or dodged. Afterwards he will reappear near you summoning a circle and if in too long, will grab you and drain some of your Blood, throw you and Stun you.
Vampiric Curse -  A status effect that will be inflicted if you are hit by most of his attacks. Has no direct effect, but after the timer runs out an explosion will occur with its centre at the location of the player. This can damage your fellow vampires except for Dracula himself. The damage can be dodged however if you are immaterial during the explosion from veil, mist trance or abilities with such effects. (Note: Vampiric Curse effect does not apply if there is only one person fighting him)
Blood Wave MKII - 2nd Phase version of Blood wave, functions the same, but at the end of the waves span will spawn blood pools which will explode.
Crimson Slasher MKII - 2nd Phase version of Crimson Slasher, but will send 2 more beams following the pattern.
Blood Crystal - 2nd Phase move. He will beckon at you and wave his hand to summon a Crystal. The crystal will circle around the arena projecting an aura, touching said aura will damage you. Can be destroyed. He may do this multiple times.
Blood Sword Rain - 2nd Phase Attack. He will summon swords that rain down on you, with small area of effect.
Nightstalker Clone - Phase 2 attack. He will summon a visibly shadowy clone of himself to do his Dread leap. Can be ignored or destroyed.
Dread Leap - He will jump at you with his sword extended outward.
Bloody Cross - 2nd Phase move. He will teleport to the center of the arena with an indicator of a cross pattern, he will summon crimson flames and will shoot partial predicted blood bolts at your location. Dodge or ward the blood bolts.
Blood Bolt Wall - 2nd Phase move. He will teleport, stand still and shoot a wall of blood bolts. Center often empty, or you can dodge or ward.
Brutal Only- Blood Vortex- At the start of Phase 4, Dracula will summon a encroaching Blood vortex, the radius shrinks until there is very little walk space. It does continuous damage while standing in it.
Brutal Only- Shockwave - During his 4th phase as the blood vortex shrinks, he will do a shockwave move (does no damage, like Henry Blackbrew the Doctor) to push you into the vortex.

phases.title: Phase 1
phases.body:
During Dracula's first phase focus on avoiding damage.  Veil behind the wolf after it jumps over you, counter the axes, avoid blood waves by either getting behind Dracula or keeping your distance, sidestep sword attacks.  When the screen goes dark, save your veil to dodge the grab at the end.
Once he drops to about 55% health, he will fly to the center of the arena and enter his second phase.  Use this time to heal or revive downed allies.

phases.title: Phase 2
phases.body: During Dracula's second phase, he will teleport to the center of the arena and become invulnerable while destroying the pillars.  When he lands he will immediately summon a Blood Crystal, and then use his various phase 2 moves.  He will no longer use Wolf Rush or Howling Axes.

phases.title: Phase 3 (Brutal Only)
phases.body:
During Dracula's third phase he will slowly regenerate his health while he spawns blood souls to boost his heal (+500 health per soul). Your objective is to kill them before they reach Dracula.  Eventually he will spawn the Heart of Dracula. Damage and feed on it to change your Blood Type to Blood of the Immortal with the following effects (will return to your previous type after the battle):
Increased Physical Power and Spell Power
Increased Movement Speed &  Increased Primary Attack Speed
Damage Reduction.
Increased Veil Cooldown Rate.
Increased Spell and Weapon Charge Gain.

phases.title: Phase 4 (Brutal Only)
phases.body: During Dracula's final phase he will channel a blood storm blocking part of the arena and only leaving a small radius (It get smaller as time goes on) with himself at the center. He will use his sword rain but the damage area is much bigger. Plus he will use his blood bolt wall ability every few seconds and release shockwaves to try to knock you into the blood storm (It hurts really bad).

entities.description:
When Dracula fell centuries ago, it seemed like the Church of Luminance had done the impossible. The death of the Immortal King. However, in his final moments, Dracula enacted his final gambit and cast a cloud over Vardoran. The blood rain that followed would plant the seeds of Dracula’s will across the realm, twisting it, and filling it with his storied essence.

After death, the Immortal King’s soul was cast out to where his otherworldly powers originated, the Shadow Realm. There he lingered, biding his time. Now the time has come. Dracula floods the world with his monstrous Legion of Noctum, having them gather the blood necessary for him to become whole once more and return to Vardoran.

sections.title: Location
sections.body:
Dracula is located at his [https://vrising.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Vardoran?marker=44 Castle] in the Ruins of Mortium. You must be carrying a  to pass through the entrance.

entities.name: Errol the Stonebreaker

meta.lore: A brutal mining foreman, just as adept at crushing stone as he is crushing bone. Not even his incredible eye for recovering and refining metals was enough to stop him from getting run out of civilised society. His violent rage makes a fine motivator for the miners.
meta.fightGuide:
Errol initially has 3 attacks:
Aftershock - At long range, he slams the ground creating a shock wave that explodes in a couple seconds.
Uppercut - At short range, he runs at the player with an uppercut swing.
Knockback - At short range, he does a spin attack that knocks the player back.
At half health he'll gain 2 additional attacks:
Summon Minions - He whistles to summon 2 Miners.
Earthquake - When he shouts "Lets hear that crunch!" he slams the ground creating 4 shock waves that explode in every direction.

entities.name: Finn the Fisherman

meta.lore: Finn is a legendary fisherman who hails from the rocky shores of Silverlight Hills. Caught fishing in the Church of Luminance's "sacred" waters, he was set to be executed by live burial at sea. The fisherman emerged from the depths, mysterious and miraculously alive, and went into hiding in the safety of the lawless lands of the Farbane Woods.
meta.fightGuide:
Fish slap: A two hit combo where he slaps the player with a fish, then follows up with a kick.
Tornado: Winds up before performing a spin attack with his fishing pole that deals damage and knocks the player back.
Throw Net: Much like the Trapper ability, Finn swings a net around before throwing it into the AoE indicator. Players still in that zone when he throws the net will be pulled to Finn's location and briefly prevented from moving. Additionally, any piranhas and pufferfish hit by the attack are also pulled and can hit the player.
Summon Piranhas: Summons 3 Hungry Piranha enemies, which slowly chase the player while attempting to use a rapidly hitting melee attack.
Summon Pufferfish: Summons 3 Pufferfish enemies which deal damage and apply  to any player they touch. Dealing any damage to a Pufferfish will cause it to be knocked away. If a Pufferfish is knocked into Finn, it will be killed and Finn will be briefly stunned. If a Pufferfish is killed by any other means it will fire 10 chilling projectiles in every direction around it.
Summon Serpent: Summons a Young Sea Serpent with a melee bite attack and ranged attack that launches 3 ice projectiles in a fan pattern and applies . Finn may use this attack multiple times if the fight lasts long enough, even if the first serpent is not killed.

Leap Slash - He will leap towards you if you're too far away and slash at you.
Triple Slash - he will swipe at you with his left, then right and his third will cover most of his sides and front.
Ice Lances - He will throw three ice lances at you, applying  if any hit.
Ice Nova - He will slam his fist into the ground, summoning an ice nova.
Encumbering Blizzard - Around 50% health he will summon a Blizzard, whiting out your screen, of which will spawn ice spikes from the ground. He will circle around you, leap and slash you.
Frigid Beam - Less then 50% health, he will cover his mouth for a moment to signal the laser, of which he will sweep in a large area, and the laser will pierce through terrain like boulders and destroy trees, if hit it will  you.

entities.name: Gaius the Cursed Champion

meta.lore: Gaius was a skilled militia captain and a famous gladiator. Annoyed at Gaius' popularity competing with his own, as well as that of the Church of Luminance, Raziel arranged for his defeat by way of a cursed blade. The event was devastating, and the Colosseum has been abandoned ever since... however, it is said that even today, issuing a challenge in the abandoned arena will be met with an answer.

entities.name: General Cassius the Betrayer

meta.lore: Once a highly skilled and respected officer within the ranks of the Church of Luminance, Cassius served as a powerful paladin who led a troupe tasked with hunting down Dracula himself. His mission ended in failure, overpowered by the Immortal King and forced into servitude. With the dark influence of his sentient blade, Nightfall Edge, affecting his mind, Cassius now serves as a loyal general for the Legion of Noctum.

entities.name: General Elena the Hollow

meta.lore: Elena was once a talented weaver, a wife, a mother, and friend. Now she is none of those things. When Dracula’s forces descended on her village and harvested its people, she hid in the chaos and witnessed the horror first-hand. Discovered by the Immortal King himself, he saw an opportunity to twist a suffering creature to his whim. He shaped her into an ice-cold killing machine, a perfect servant for the Legion of Noctum.
meta.fightGuide:
(All attacks  if ed)
Ice Arrow - Elena does 4 simple bolt attacks in succession that apply .
Ice Bolts - Elena shoots 5 freezing bolts, similar to the Longbow's Q ability.
Shard Rain - Elena shoots out 15 bolts that are similar to the Crossbow rain of bolts. These arrows freeze the player and deal heavy damage.
Ice Pillar - Elena raises an ice pillar from the ground, elevating her from attacks. The pillar can take damage and be destroyed early, and she can still attack while on the ice pillar. It disappears after 10 seconds.

entities.name: General Valencia the Depraved

meta.lore: Valencia was once a human baroness, part of an affluent noble family from before the great war. Always hungry for power, ambitious, and utterly without moral tethers, she saw the rise of Dracula and his legions as an opportunity to surpass her human limitations and become something greater. Impressed with her utter depravity, Dracula granted the baroness’ wish. Valencia now serves as a vicious general of the Legion of Noctum.
meta.fightGuide:
A Thousand Spears - Valencia dashes backwards and thrusts her spears forward in a cone multiple times, not giving the player a chance to cast spells, dash, or attack. She always initiates the fight with this attack. She does this attack if you're close by after summoning Bloody Iron Maiden or being spit out by it.
Spear Throw - She throws a single spear that pulls the player in. She does this attack if you're far away after summoning Bloody Iron Maiden or being spit out by it.
Bloody Iron Maiden - At the 75% max health threshhold, she will place an Iron Maiden in the Center of the arena, which if near will drain 25% of your Blood Pool. Spins around slowly to face the player, and shoots out spears that pull the player in at range. Up close it will try to capture the player, dealing damage and stunning upon being spit out. Can be destroyed.
Thrust Kick - She will glow red, and sprint behind the player and attempt to kick you into the Iron Maiden. Only happens while the Iron Maiden is active.
Spear Hail - Valencia either dashes backwards a small distance or leaps a great distance away, before throwing many spears into the air and they crash down, creating small craters. Can happen at any point after the first Iron Maiden has been summoned.
Spear Spin - Valencia spins her spears back and forth, damaging players who touch it and negating all damage from in front of her.

entities.name: Gorecrusher the Behemoth

meta.lore: Once a loyal warrior in the Legion of Noctum. So dedicated was his fanaticism that upon Dracula’s death to the hands of the Church of Luminance, the warrior severed his shield-bearing arm in an act of shame. In a delirious haze, he wandered into the wilderness of the Cursed Forest expecting to die. The corruption within gave him not death, however, but something much worse.
meta.fightGuide:
Swipes - Gorecrusher will prepare before performing two wide swings followed by a thrust with his club arm.
Slam Combo - Gorecrusher will let out a roar and begin to glow with Illusion magic before slamming down his club three times, once to his right then once to his left before slamming it straight ahead. Each of the slams stun the player if they connect.
Charge - Gorecrusher will prepare to charge a short distance. If the player is hit by the charge they will be flipped a long distance backwards and stunned.
Ground slam - Gorecrusher will raise both his arms as a damage circle appears in front of him. When the circle fills up he will slam the ground, doing damage and knocking back the player if they are in the circle, as well as sending out 5 lines of shockwaves in random directions.
Leap - If the player gets too far away from Gorecrusher, the Behemoth will leap at the player, signaled by a damage circle filling up. Gorecrusher will not leap if he's performing a charge attack.
Charge Combo - At about 80% health, Gorecrusher will gain the ability to do 3 long range, non-stunning charges one after the other. Every charge will be delayed and they all will attempt to target ahead of where the player is moving rather than where the player is currently in an attempt to intercept them.
Illusionary Summons - At about 70% health, Gorecrusher will jump away from the player (while unlikely, his jump away from the player can still deal damage to them if he lands on them). Afterwards, he will summon an illusionary wolf and illusionary bear to attack the player while also apply a warping effect to the screen similar to the Trippy Shroom for 15 seconds, during which time he is also immune. The illusionary animals will act similarly to their standard counterparts and will linger in the fight until they die and will not drop anything. Once Gorecrusher's immunity ends he will run up to the player before quickly slamming down with his club, stunning the player if it connects.
Wisp Dance - At about 50% health, Gorecrusher will roar, slowing the player and casting a very powerful version of Wisp Dance which will summon a large amount of wisps from his very center. The wisps will linger on the field for a long time and, if they come into contact with the player, will deal damage and apply weaken , reducing their damage and movement speed.
Soul - At about 30% health, Gorecrusher will stop to roar and knockback the player, summoning a Gorecrusher Soul in the process which is essentially an illusionary clone of himself. The clone is able to perform all of Gorecrusher's attacks independently of the real one except for his leap, his Wisp Dance and Illusionary summons. If the soul would die it will instead drop down becoming immune and will stop attacking while it regenerates. The soul will resume attacking once it reaches half health and the only way to kill the soul for good is killing Gorecrusher himself.

It is advised for the player to use the Bloodmoon Armour set for this fight alongside their choice of Blood Merlot Amulet upgrade and blood type, based on their preferred playstyle. As for abilities, Sanguine Coil can aid the player greatly due to its reliable healing off-sets the fight's more chaotic moments, while Mist Trance can be used to dodge Gorecrusher's stunning attacks while also repositioning. Blocking abilities such as Ward of the Damned can fill a similar role.

General Tips: When attempting to defeat Gorecrusher, the player has to be very careful with how far away from Gorecrusher they are at all times. In general, Gorecrusher's attacks reward the player being aggressive, most easily seen with his Ground Slam which is at it's easiest to dodge if the player was already standing near the boss, although the player still needs to be careful of the shockwave lines. Consistently staying behind Gorecrusher is also a great way of staying out of danger. With all that said, it isn't impossible to deal damage to Gorecrusher from a safer distance, though the player should be careful when doing so as straying too far away will cause Gorecrusher to leap at them. It should also be noted that the only attacks that can't be countered or blocked during this fight are Gorecrusher's Ground Slam, his Leap and the illusionary bear's Ground Slam.
Swipes and Slam Combos: If the player gets behind Gorecrusher after he starts performing these attacks they will not only be safe from harm but can freely swing at him with their weapon. The player can also attempt to simply walk away from Gorecrusher when he performs these attacks, although it isn't as reliable.
Charge: While this attack can be easily side-stepped, it is much safer to dodge it using your Travel Ability.
Ground Slam and Leap: When Gorecrusher performs these attacks he will always be on the edge of their respective circles rather than in the middle of them. This makes it so that staying near Gorecrusher during the Ground Slam or running towards where he was before leaping is the safest way to deal with these attacks. It's also worth noting that, in the event of the player being unable to get out of the circle in time, it is still possible to avoid taking damage if you time your Travel Ability at the right time.
Charge Combo: While this attack may be seemingly very difficult to dodge, the player can dodge every charge by simply walking. To do this, move left to right while Gorecrusher is preparing to charge, which is when he raises his head. While he is lowering his head, move in the opposite direction of where you were moving previously then repeat this process until he stops charging.
Illusionary Summons: At this point, the player should be familiar with how to fight wolves and bears. The problem of this attack comes when the summons interfere with you trying to dodge Gorecrusher's attacks after he stops being immune. As such, killing the summons during the 15 seconds should be the priority. If this can't be done, heavily injuring them and killing them after is the best course of action. The player should also be mindful of the fast attack that Gorecrusher performs right after becoming vulnerable to damage again and should save their Travel Ability or any defensive ability such as a Counter or Bulwark in order to not take damage.
Wisp Dance: The player should be very careful when Gorecrusher gains this attack as the boss will not push the player back when performing this attack, making it possible to get hit by a lot of the wisps when it is first performed. To circumvent the aftermath of the wisps spawning, the player should get as far away from where they spawned as possible, even if it means making Gorecrusher leap at them.
Gorecrusher Soul: At this point, the fight will become extremely chaotic and a misstep will cause the player to lose a large amount of health as one Gorecrusher is able to stun you while the other prepares another attack. Killing the soul is advisable to make the fight more manageable due to how frail it is. A good way of softening up the soul while also damaging Gorecrusher is using an Ultimate Ability such as Arctic Leap or Mirror Strike. After the first time the soul is killed it will become easier to do so again as it always revives with only half it's health. Although risky, once Gorecrusher is nearly dead, it is worth considering to ignore the soul completely in the hopes of finishing the fight.

sections.title: Attacks
sections.body:
Swipes - Gorecrusher will prepare before performing two wide swings followed by a thrust with his club arm.
Slam Combo - Gorecrusher will let out a roar and begin to glow with Illusion magic before slamming down his club three times, once to his right then once to his left before slamming it straight ahead. Each of the slams stun the player if they connect.
Charge - Gorecrusher will prepare to charge a short distance. If the player is hit by the charge they will be flipped a long distance backwards and stunned.
Ground slam - Gorecrusher will raise both his arms as a damage circle appears in front of him. When the circle fills up he will slam the ground, doing damage and knocking back the player if they are in the circle, as well as sending out 5 lines of shockwaves in random directions.
Leap - If the player gets too far away from Gorecrusher, the Behemoth will leap at the player, signaled by a damage circle filling up. Gorecrusher will not leap if he's performing a charge attack.

sections.title: Other notes
sections.body:
If the player becomes hidden through effects such as Veil of Blood while Gorecrusher or his Soul is preparing his slam combo, the boss will not begin slamming until the player is revealed. This can be circumvented by using these effects in the window between the boss roaring and performing the attack.
When performing his charge combo, Gorecrusher will attempt to charge at the player's last known location if the player becomes hidden. This can be easily seen with Travel Abilities that hide the player.
While Gorecrusher himself isn't active when he summons the illusionary animals, the Gorecrusher Soul is active during this time.
Gorecrusher and his Soul can begin an attack in the middle of another attack if the first attack is delayed, causing the first attack to be cancelled in the process.
The Gorecrusher Soul has considerably less health than the real Gorecrusher.

entities.name: Goreswine the Ravager

meta.lore: A mad cultist, too far gone to be really intelligible. The Malevolent being they serve pushes them to desecrate all things, with little regard for practicality. They wear a rotting pig's head as a decorative mask.
meta.fightGuide:
Corrupted Skull - A ranged attack that fires a single skull and snares the player if it hits.
Bone Explosion - An explosion that covers the ground in a poison cloud.
Quad Explosion - They shout "Suffer for us, suffer!", spawns 4 poison clouds total, and teleports elsewhere.
Ultimate Explosion - At half health they shout "Drink it in, the chaos!", becomes temporarily invulnerable, spawns multiple poison clouds 3 times in a row, and teleports elsewhere.

entities.name: Grayson the Armourer

meta.lore: The working arm and logistical mastermind of the bandit forces, Grayson is the backbone of their operation. As the quartermaster of a band of chaotic outlaws, murderers, and thieves, he's the stern voice of reason that keeps their gang well fed and well equipped.
meta.fightGuide:
Overhead Swing - Basic melee attack.
Uppercut - At short range, he runs at the player with an uppercut swing.
Get Over Here - He throws 3 hammers which pull the player toward him if they get hit.
Knockback - He shouts "I'm gonna hammer you out!" and does a spin attack that knocks the player back.
Caltrops - He shouts "I've got the tool for the job!" and throws multiple caltrops to the ground, dealing damage and snaring the player if they step on them. They can be destroyed by equipping the invulnerability armors and walking over them. While invulnerable, the player cannot use any attacks.
Summon Minion - He shouts "You can't stop me!" and summons a Poacher.

meta.lore: A true artist with a deep love for the process of creation. She thinks of herself much like she thinks of her glass. It is beautiful and practical, chaotic and tame, strong and yet delicate. In the same way, her style of glassblowing is methodical and daring. While she is a master of her craft, she wears many savage burn scars for her haphazard approach.

entities.name: Henry Blackbrew the Doctor

meta.lore: Doctor Henry Blackbrew was once humankind's last hope against the forces of Dracula, before the Church of Luminance came along. With their newly found faith and weapons of light, mankind turned on the Doctor for his sick methodology and pursuit of human evolution, declaring him a heretic. Banished alongside his students, he went on to found The Trancendum and began constructing a society in his image. With the help of a resource he refers to as "Blood Type E" he's managed to maintain his youth, and keep his twisted pursuit of "progress" alive for well over 800 years.
meta.fightGuide:
All attacks inflict Electric Amplify which increases damage taken by 5% per stack.
Lasers - He'll shoot 4 lasers in every direction.
Homing Orb - He'll shoot an electrical orb that tracks the player
Discharge - He'll shout "Try me now!" and do a counter attack.
Wall Lasers - During the fight, lines of electricity will cross the room and disappear after a while. They can be crossed with a Dash ability.
Wall Orbs - He'll charge one of the corners of the room and 4 waves of 4 electrical orbs will shoot out.
At half health, he'll surround the area with a ring of electricity and more wall lasers will start to appear.
Knockback - He'll charge up a skill at the center of the room and shoot 7 pulses of energy that try to push you against the wall.

entities.name: Jade the Vampire Hunter

meta.lore: A huntress from a noble house in Brighthaven, famous for their development of new-age weaponry that rivals even the genius of the scientists of Gloomrot. After the disappearance of her brother, rumor has it the expert marksman stole an impressive arsenal of experimental weapons to aid in her hunting down the culprit.
meta.fightGuide:
Shot - The basic ranged attack.
Silence - She'll fire a red bullet that inflicts Silence, rendering the player unable to attack for a couple seconds.
Caltrops - She'll throw multiple caltrops to the ground, dealing damage and stunning if the player steps on it.
Bomb - If the player is in close proximity to Jade, she'll drop a bomb at her feet.
Invisibility - She'll occasionally go into stealth and change her positioning.
Deadeye - She'll shout "One shot, one kill!" and shoot a tracking bullet.
Machine Gun - At half health she'll shout "Dance for me!" and shoot 6 bullets in quick succession.
Chaos Barrage - At half health she'll shout "You're done!" and throw 4 chaos bolts at the player.
Brutal and Incursion: She shoots more often, her regular shot can inflict stun and is often lead up with her Silence shot.

entities.name: Jakira the Shadow Huntress

meta.lore: Jakira was not always a member of the Venom Blades. Like many, she first resisted their onslaught, standing against the great witch Megara and her raiders as they descended upon her homeland and consumed its forests. A master duelist, Jakira always believed in strength, and now she serves the strong with unflinching loyalty. Like many Venom Blades, she's mixed her skills with their corrupted magic, alchemy, and brutal techniques, always looking for new ways to prove herself and earn her place at her masters' side. Despite her stealthy nature, this cocky huntress always warns her prey just before she strikes.

entities.name: Kodia the Ferocious Bear

meta.lore: This mother bear is said to be ancient. Rumor has it that she wears a scar from every Bandit King that has ever lived, a rite of passage for the position. Her life stands as testament to the fact that no bandit leader has ever done well enough to finish the job.
meta.fightGuide:
Smash - Basic melee attack.
Crush - It slams the ground, causing a large number of rocks to fall from the ceiling 4 times in a circle radiating out from them. These rocks cannot be blocked by counters.
Rage - It roars and glows red, automatically snaring the player and gaining increased attack speed for 3 attacks.
Charge - It crouches on its haunches before charging forward in a straight line.

entities.name: Kriig the Undead General

meta.lore: A truly impressive strategic mind in life, Kriig saw an early end for his mistaken faith in his allies. Though he was sent to an unjust grave, he was like any great mastermind, and had contingencies in place for just such an occasion. A dark deal with an entity of undeath allowed him to rise again and take his revenge. Now he serves the Cult of the Damned with renewed purpose, fully immersing himself into their enigmatic cause.
meta.fightGuide:
Slash - He sweeps his scythe in a wide arc forward, slashing a large area in front of him and on his sides.
Reaper Whirlwind - His scythe glows green and he draws back his scythe horizontally behind him with both hands, before spinning in a circle while dashing forward. This attack snares the player if it hits them.
Chain Harpoons - He draws back his left arm and throws 3 harpoons towards the player, which drag them back towards Kriig and briefly snare them if they hit.
Bone Circle - Kriig raises his scythe in the air, and after a brief delay summons an unholy circle around him that deals damage in melee range.
Ward of the Damned - He summons a shield similar to the player's , blocking any attacks that hit it and summoning skeletons that fight alongside Kriig.

entities.name: Leandra the Shadow Priestess

meta.lore: There are few creatures on the face of Vardoran as ancient as Leandra. Mysterious and surrounded with shadow magic and undeath, it is said that when Dracula fell, and the poisonous blood rains soaked Vardoran, she stood willingly in the deadly downpour. Some say she embraced the dark power of that corruption and made it her own. Today she serves as High Priestess of the Cult of the Damned.
meta.fightGuide:
Shadow Bolt - She swings her left arm in a backhand motion, firing a single bolt of shadow at the player
Shadow Orbs - She holds her left hand behind her as it glows purple, then fires three shadow orbs toward the player. The two orbs on the sides will arc in a semi-circle, and when all 3 orbs converge at the end of their arc they will detonate and deal damage in a large area around them.
Summon Shadow Soldier - She raises her left hand in the air and summons a shadow soldier that dashes toward the player after a brief delay. The shadow will make a single melee attack and then disappear, but can also be destroyed earlier by taking any amount of damage.
At half health, she'll gain an additional attack:
Summon Shadow Army - She levitates into the air and shouts "Do you hear them? They're coming!", and disappears as darkness obscures the edges of the player's vision. She then summons 4 shadow soldiers which will attack the player one after the other before disappearing. Leandra can use this ability multiple times per fight.

entities.name: Lord Styx the Night Champion

meta.lore: A legendary Vampire from the age of Dracula who was reawakened by the call of the Immortal King. Known for his ferocity on the battlefield against the forces of the church and rival Vampire alike, he has more than earned his place as the Night Champion of the Legion of Noctum. His presence over the operation at the heart of Dracula’s Demise must be of vital importance to Dracula’s plans.
meta.fightGuide:
Double Kill - Styx does two fast slashes and a lunge.
Death Spin - He spins in a circle firing red blades in a 360° angle dealing damage. His spin attack deals area damage (for  the circle) while the blades deal single target damage.
Lunge - At 80% health Styx unlocks a new ability. He teleports behind the player and dashes towards them.
Bat Swarm - He summons three bat-energy balls. Two from the sides closing in on the player and one from the front (it can sometimes curve)
Gargoyles - At 50% HP he jumps into the air and summons two gargoyles to aid him in the fight.
Ultimate Power -  Styx levitates into the air darkening the screen of the player and summons 10 of his bat swarm attacks.
Jump - Styx can now jump into the air and inflict "Heart strike"
Teleport - He can now teleport behind the player.

meta.lore: An energetic, maniacal alchemist with a famously resilient constitution. Lucile obsesses over creating the perfect Venom Sap brew for any occasion. That inspiration just so happens to strike when she forgets to switch out the filters in her protective face mask.

entities.name: Mairwyn the Elementalist

meta.lore: A dangerous spell-caster in tune with the most ephemeral qualities of nature. Mairwyn speaks to the winds, which whisper for change, chaos, and destruction. However, she seems content to only massacre those who wander too close to her Grove.
meta.fightGuide:
Fire vortex - Mairwyn conjures a fiery vortex, throwing out 4 fireballs at 90 degree angles to each other as she spins and moves around. The fireballs apply a burn debuff.
Sparkles - Mairwyn puts an electric charge on the target, causing sparkles to spawn around them. They spawn in four directions around the taget, moving toward the target. The sparkles apply a stun.
Ice shard volly - Mairwyn throws a volley of 3 ice shards, slowing on hit.
Large ice shard - Mairwyn throws a large ice shard, stunning on hit.
Secondary attacks (cast only while low health):
Wind blast - Mairwyn yells "Back to hell with you!" conjuring a large wind blast over a time. Enemies hit are sent flying outwards.
Mirror image - Mairwyn turns invisible and teleports, creating a mirror image as she reappears. Both use the Shock blast ability at first, but Mairwyn herself switches to her normal abilities after a while.
Shock blast - Mairwyn (or her mirror image) throws 3 lightning balls, stunning on hit.
Frost and fire - Mairwyn freezes herself and summons a large fireball, the fireball rolls around, throwing small fireballs toward its target. the smaller fireballs can be intercepted by the frozen Mairwyn.

entities.name: Maja the Dark Savant

meta.lore: A brilliant, obsessive scholar that resides in an ancient family library, discovering its long-lost secrets in pursuit of a goal intuitively passed through her family's bloodline. The culmination of generations of work is at her ink-stained fingertips... to open a way to the world of demons.
meta.fightGuide:
Paper Barrage - She swings her book in front of her, firing 4 lines of pages at the player.
Ink Bolt - She holds her left hand back then swings her wand and fires an ink projectile at the player. If it hits them, it summons an Ink Demon to aid Maja. This projectile pierces through enemies and can therefore summon multiple Ink Demons in a single cast if it hits multiple players or summons (e.g. the skeletons created by Unholy spells).
Ink Splatter - She shouts "Flee interloper!" or "A taste of knowledge!", then creates a large ink area around her that explodes after a brief delay and summons an Ink Demon.
Summon Ink Demons - She creates a small burst of ink dealing damage in an area around her, shouts "Rise Demons! Accept these vessels!" or "Witness my little devils!", then disappears while 3 ink projectiles begin springing up out of the ground. These projectiles create Ink Demons upon landing and will also snare the player if they hit them. Maja reappears in a random location once this attack ends.
Consume - She shouts "A sacrifice is required!" or "Lend me your power!" before channeling to create a large book in front of her that shields an Ink Demon and begins to drag it towards her. If the Ink Demon is dragged all the way to the book, it slams shut around it, destroying the demon and healing Maja for a substantial amount of health. This ability can be canceled by killing the demon before it reaches the book.
At half health, she'll gain an additional attack:
Paper Cut - She shouts "Death by a thousand paper cuts!" or "The exquisite suffering of a paper cut!" or "Here is some mandatory reading!" or "Do you also thirst for research?!", and summons 7 lines of pages that fire at the player, followed by 7 more from a different angle after a delay. These projectiles are spaced further apart than those created by her Paper Barrage ability and can be avoided by standing between them.

entities.name: Megara the Serpent Queen

meta.lore:
There was once a small village of warriors, a place of little significance. When the great witch Megara appeared the villagers reacted with suspicion, gathering their forces to stand against her. Megara gave them a display of power that inspired such terror it crushed all hope of resistance, driving them to their knees.

"I am your Queen! The greatest half of you will become my first subjects, and will walk by my side. Come dusk, each of you that are holding the heart of one of your neighbors will earn your place."

Those who obeyed became the first Venom Blades, worthy of receiving the secret of Venom Sap. This fuels their war effort, but more importantly, the great witch herself.

phases.title: Phase 1
phases.body:
Megara is found at the center of the arena, surrounded by her followers. damaging them or Megara herself causes her to initiate combat, instantly killing her followers and pushing back the player.
Activate wells: Causes two wells to activate and throw area targeted balls of venom around which make puddles on the ground for a while. Deals moderate damage.
Venom bolt: Throws an area targeted bolt of venom, jumping around twice before disappearing.
Spiralling venom: Causes an explosion in an area dealing moderate damage. Multiple venom bolts will spiral out of the location, which deal minor damage and can be blocked.
Scream: Dashes towards (or away from, if too close) the target and winds up a scream in a cone which knocks back and deals serious damage.
Laser: Winds up a linear laser and tries to intercept the target before shooting it, dealing serious damage.
Volley: Dashes around, then launches a volley of four homing projectiles (two on each side). Can be blocked, each projectile deals moderate damage.
Flight: Levitates and becomes untargetable, moves to the other side of the arena while shooting area targeted projectiles dealing moderate damage.

phases.title: Phase 2
phases.body:
Megara levitates and moves to the venom pool at the northern center, transforming to her true form. For the rest of the fight:
Megara will have a body and a tail, both being targetable and active.
Neither the body nor the tail can move around, being only able to move between wells (while they start at the northern pool, neither parts will go back there) . Once the body submerges, the runes around the well she'll emerge from will glow white.
The tail only has a slam ability which stuns, with hits being practically lethal as it leave you defenceless to the body's abilities.
The body will use different abilities based on distance to the target.
A venom storm will appear around the arena, closing in at times forcing you to get close to the boss.

phases.title: Phase 3
phases.body: Megara will use the same abilities at the second phase. She also periodically summons four spiralling disks, which can be blocked and deal moderate damage.

Neither the body nor the tail can move around, being only able to move between wells (while they start at the northern pool, neither parts will go back there) . Once the body submerges, the runes around the well she'll emerge from will glow white.
The tail only has a slam ability which stuns, with hits being practically lethal as it leave you defenceless to the body's abilities.
The body will use different abilities based on distance to the target.
A venom storm will appear around the arena, closing in at times forcing you to get close to the boss.

sections.title: Phase 3
sections.body: Megara will use the same abilities at the second phase. She also periodically summons four spiralling disks, which can be blocked and deal moderate damage.

entities.name: Meredith the Bright Archer

meta.lore: Meredith is a true believer in the Church of Luminance. She believes her power is a gift from the Light to wield against dark forces, much as the original Paladins were given the Light to strike down Dracula and the Vampire legions. As brave as she is naive to the Church’s descent into avarice and gluttony, this holy archer is blinded by the light, focused only on her pursuit of justice at any cost.
meta.fightGuide:
Her arrows will heal her Militia allies if they strike them.
Arrow Shot - She fires a single arrow at the player.
Blessed Shot - She shouts "Bless this shot!" then fires an an arrow in the direction the player is moving, predicting their path. This arrow deals heavy damage and incapacitates the player if it hits them.
Dash - She occasionally dashes around the area up to 4 times, damaging targets she passes through.
At half health, she'll gain 2 additional attacks:
Summon Militia Guard - She shouts "For Luminance!", and summons 2 Militia Guards.
Arrow Barrage - She shouts "Light, guide my arrows!", then shoots 10 arrows upward that will fall around her. This attack stuns the player if they get hit.

entities.name: Morian the Stormwing Matriarch

meta.lore: The most dangerous of her kind, and fiercely protective of her tribe. It's said that the harpies are attracted to only the finest gemstones, and none has a sharper eye for quality than the matriarch herself. Wealthy folk are warned to keep their jewels out of sight if they dare travel outside the protection of Brighthaven.

entities.name: Nibbles the Putrid Rat

meta.lore: Farmers try to be diligent in keeping their pest problems under control, as legend says that any place too infested might find themselves visited by the Putrid Rat. No one is quite sure how it gets in, but they know it by the stench of rotting flesh and its carnivorous appetite.
meta.fightGuide:
Bite - The standard melee attack.
Rage - Nibbles glows red, then melee attacks 6 times in a row.
Poison Explosion - Nibbles shakes its coat and releases a green poison mist that explodes in an area around it after a delay.
Summon Minions - Nibbles burrows into the ground, temporarily leaving the fight while summoning 3 s. More rats will steadily join the fight until 9 have been summoned in total.

entities.name: Nicholaus the Fallen

meta.lore: A necromancer driven out of high society in Silverlight for his indulgence in the dark arts. Now he lives among the undead, using his unliving servants to fulfill his needs, as well as bring him back unwilling subjects for his experiments.
meta.fightGuide:
Green Bolt - He fires a single skull ranged attack.
Teleport - He raises up in the air, disappears, then creates an area of effect under the player. After a moment he reappears in the area, and inflicts Fear on the player if haven't left the area, forcing them to run away from him.
Skulls - He says "Your bones will be mine!", then radiates 3 waves of skull projectiles in all directions around him. These projectiles wind back and forth while traveling through the air.
Summon Minions - He says "Behold!", then summons 3 Armoured Skeletons and 1 Skeleton Crossbow (Armoured).
Summon Army - He says "Let's test that meat suit of yours!", then summons a large group of 14 Skeletons.

entities.name: Octavian the Militia Captain

meta.lore: An old soldier and a veteran of many battles, Octavian is perhaps the most trusted man in all of Dunley. The militia serves him without question, and he in turn serves them to the best of his ability. Don't let his age fool you, he's got plenty of fight left in him.
meta.fightGuide:
Wide Swing - He will swing his sword arching the front most of his sides and foreward, spawns a few projectiles
Greatsword Reverse - He will swing his sword vertically which will shoot a projectile, if hit by the projectile will bring you right behind him and stun you.
Dash - He will dash at you with his sword out.
Minion Summon - He will yell "To me!" which will summon a Militia Longbow Enemies.
Enrage - He will glow red and start dash striking you.
Hurricane Spin - He will say "Here's an old trick" will start spinning around the arena, spawning projectiles as he spins.
Brutal and Incursion Rift: His Enrage is changed to a jump attack which he will do multiple jumps. He will also chain attack his Wide Swing and Greatsword Reverse.

entities.name: Polora the Feywalker

meta.lore: A powerful psychopomp that taps into mysterious spiritual sources. Polora is one of the only known mortal links to fairy kind and driven to the brink of sanity by her intimate connection to nature. Her dream-like home is alive with unique, enchanted plant life.
meta.fightGuide:
All her attacks as well as her spirit's attacks can pass through all targets in their path. If hitting the player, they deal damage. If hitting Polora or her spirits, then they heal them.
Spirit Wave - Polora does a stationary channel, lifting her left arm up, before releasing 3 spread out spirit projectiles that move in a wave-like pattern.
Spirit Wolf - Polora does a short channel in front of her before launching a spirit wolf in a straight line. The wolf deals damage/heals depending on target hit. After a short delay, the wolf will bounce to a new target, up to 5 times, for a total of 6 hits. It can bounce back to Polora.
Fear - If the player is in close proximity to Polora, she'll shout "Begone!"and start a second long channel. When it ends she will Fear all targets in a small radius around her, forcing them to run away from her.
Invisibility - If the player is in close proximity to Polora, she will turn invisible for a few seconds, and gain increased movement speed. If afflicted by , her movement can be tracked.
Summon Minion - After losing 25% of her health, Polora will periodically shout "Spirits, hear me!" and summon a Pixie. They fire ranged wave-like spirit attacks, but their aiming turn rate is slower. If killed, Polora may resummon a new one.
